scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src server/src shared client/vite.config.ts *.json server/*.json client/*.json README.md
